The fan has diameter \(6\) feet, so its radius is \(3\) feet.

The circumference traveled in one revolution is:
\[
2\pi r = 2\pi(3)=6\pi \text{ feet}
\]

At \(20\) revolutions per minute, the fly travels:
\[
20 \cdot 6\pi = 120\pi \text{ feet per minute}
\]

The time to travel \(19{,}404\pi\) feet is:
\[
\frac{19{,}404\pi}{120\pi}=\frac{19{,}404}{120}=161.7
\]

Rounded to the nearest whole number:
\[
162
\]

The answer is 162.
